verification.windowsRuntime: verification/run-013-v5/runtime-results.json: all functional checks passed, real movement 3.025m, cabin collision and walkway grounding verified. 1440x900 Iris Xe short samples: menu 59.8, overview 60, walking 56.5, portrait 60 FPS; final-view value 54.1. No background builds or Blender rendering during the tour.
verification.webRuntime: verification/web-004-v5/runtime-results.json: passed real-keyboard completion, reload persistence, walking and ending return in a fresh Edge profile with default autoplay. Audio context resume observed; no captured browser exceptions. Unity retains hidden-shader, INVALID_ENUM and sound-loading diagnostics. Foreground 1440x900 Iris Xe interval-FPS medians from six 0.5s samples: menu 47.60, ending 49.05, walking 34.20. Rolling-average medians include prior views and are not used as current-view performance. No claim of a Web performance gain over v4.
verification.finalVisualComparison: verification/visual-review.html uses run-013-v5 native captures, original reference images, and v4/v5 portraits. The new exposed-hair character has revised proportions, integrated nose/lips, shallow eyes and eyelids, softer sleeves and a lowered hood. Coarse candidate cloth was corrected. Skin/eye transitions, fabric folds and material naturalness remain simpler than the reference; superiority is not achieved.
verification.shaderChecks: verification/v5-shader-checks.json; fixed FoliagePaint retains authored vegetation and original lighting/wind, SRP compatibility code 0. No unused opaque texture copy. Diagnostic v4 omissions are not shipping speedup measurements.
